description: This file defines a set of XML-based simple methods for customer-related operations in the order management of the OFBiz framework. It includes validation, creation, and update procedures for customer information, such as contact details and addresses.

methods.name: validateCustomerInfo
methods.description: Validates customer information including personal details, email, address, and phone numbers.

methods.name: createUpdateCustomerInfo
methods.description: Creates or updates customer contact information such as email addresses, phone numbers, and addresses.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Handles the process of creating a new customer, including validation, role assignment, and optional login creation.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information, including personal details and contact information, with validation.
